## Assumptions to verify on import
- "Extract From File" (fromJson) is assumed to output the parsed dataset under `data`. If your n8n version places it elsewhere, adjust the first line of the Code node.
- Backend is reached at `http://backend:8000/ingest` via the shared `ap-agent-net` docker network (service name `backend`, per docker-compose.yml) — not localhost.
- This simulates ALL THREE intake channels (email/portal/EDI) as one batch replay of the mock dataset, since there's no real inbox/portal/EDI feed to poll in a self-hosted demo.
- The Loop Over Items node deliberately sends one invoice at a time: the hosted Ollama API rate-limits a parallel 200-invoice replay.
